concept: Review and integration: a personal approach to long-view, deliberate decision-making
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across backward-planning, understanding others' interests, and managing risk — what's your personal throughline for strategic decisions?
exercise.practice: Adult writes a short personal statement on what strategic thinking means to them in practice

assessment.success_marker: adult produces a personal statement referencing at least two of the three adult-stage scenarios
